header: Get a written offer for larger groups
lead: Above 15 practitioners or three addresses, list prices no longer fit. Tell us about your organisation, and we send you a written price.
note: We never ask for patient data, and you sign nothing to get an offer. If the list price suits you better, the offer says so.

steps.title: Send us four details
steps.text: Practitioners, addresses, treatments per month and your current system.

steps.title: One 30-minute call
steps.text: Only if something needs clarifying. Many offers go out without a call.

steps.title: A written offer in three working days
steps.text: Itemised, with migration and training listed apart from the running costs.

steps.title: Valid for 60 days
steps.text: Long enough for a committee decision. The price stays fixed during that time.
